description:
RE-CUT 2026-09-15 (measured at fz-gee/fold-arc 45ae2ac0b): the fork is unreachable from source, so the original red fixture cannot be written. allow_other_structs is written in production only by Types::runtime_type_predicate (src/compiler2/types/mod.rs ~1810, named_structs.cofinite); across the whole matrix corpus (765 tests, three doors, 129,791 predicate constructions with named_structs.cofinite) every one also had widen_non_structs == true, which forces tuples to TupleShapes::any(); zero had a finite tuple arity set. With arities any, emit_tuple_axis answers !known_named for a STRUCT value, which already admits every tuple, so other_flag (native_codegen/runtime_test.rs ~338-346) can only contribute for a struct that is neither a registered tuple arity nor a named struct, and no such runtime value exists. The divergence needs allow_other_structs WITH a finite tuple axis; that requires a map clause with no positive signature, which only an any-derived difference produces, and such a descr carries cofinite opaques -> widen_non_structs -> tuple axis any. There is no tuple type constructor to subtract the tuple universe with.

What survives, as one fold commit under fz-gee: (1) pure deletions: TupleShapes::admits_arity (runtime_type_predicate.rs ~814) duplicates FiniteSet::contains; runtime_test.rs ~369-372 recomputes shapes().map(len).sort().dedup(), the set TupleShapes::exact already stores (~770). (2) Route receive.rs ~1529-1561 emit_tuple_arity_test and ir_interp/backend.rs ~3389 is_tuple_arity through RuntimeTypePredicate::tuple_arity(n) (receive trades an 'arity not pre-registered' CodegenError for a static false, which the shared emitter already treats as 'no value can carry it'). (3) The OtherStructs axis is inert in emitted code today: for every reachable predicate the tuple axis (is_any) already answers for struct values. The concordant fold is deleting the second reading (other_flag) rather than aligning it; it needs a unit-level red test at the emitter/matcher layer (a hand-built predicate with allow_other_structs and a finite tuple axis) since no source program reaches it, or explicit authorization to land as a by-construction fold. Record in runtime_test.rs's moduledoc that the other-structs axis leaves to the tuple axis exactly the arities the predicate names.
title: [BUG] allow_other_structs admits different arities on the interpreter matcher and the native boxed emitter when the tuple axis names a nested arity
